name: PRODUCER -> FIXED FIXTURE -> CONSUMER -> DIFFERENTIAL
question: Did the consumer of a dead producer's output actually depend on that output, or would any fixture have produced the same downstream verdict?

steps.does: seeded replay of the producer with an input-fingerprinting manifest (archaeon H3 pattern; other producers via NT-055 fresh-interpreter runner)
hash the fixture spec so the same bytes are fed to every consumer arm
the historical gate (Erebos residue eligibility as the exemplar) run on fixture and on a shuffled / constant fixture
IDENTICAL / INDETERMINATE / NOT_IDENTICAL between arms; accuracy agreement alone cannot buy IDENTICAL
flag a consumer that conflates distinct fixtures (B1)

output_contract: {fixture_hash, consumer_verdict_on_fixture, consumer_verdict_on_null_fixture, differential, degenerate}; a consumer whose verdict is IDENTICAL across real and null fixtures is recorded as CONSUMER_BLIND
